Amna Nawaz: Well, for a closer look now at Huang's return to Nvidia and the national security implications, I'm joined by Dmitri Alperovitch.

Dmitri, we heard, as Liz reported, that the Nvidia board said they had assurances of some kind from senior government officials, the president also then saying that he gave them assurances, even as investigations continue to unfold here about exactly what kind of national security risk this does pose.
Amna Nawaz: Dmitri, less than two weeks ago when we spoke after Huang was ousted, you said the board had to act immediately after revelations of his affairs.

So we don't know what information he may have passed, either about Nvidia, maybe about U.S. government policy here, whether he was knowingly involved in the smuggling of these chips that she was involved in.
Geoff Bennett: Jim, you heard the president Liz's reporting there referred to Huang as a genius.

And even just last night there was a New York Times story alleging that Alice Huang, as mistress, had ongoing relationship with the Chinese Ministry of State Security, essentially the Chinese version of CIA.
